That evening he wrote a letter of his own, sealed it in the same bottle, and threw it back to the tide, trusting the sea to carry one more promise onward.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，又很快消失在尽头。便利店的灯亮着，店员靠在柜台打盹。清洁工推着小车，扫过落叶与昨夜的喧嚣。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟儿先于人们醒来。这是属于寂静的时刻，也是黎明前最温柔的呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of itself.\n• Like looking in two mirrors facing each other, each step reflects a tinier version until it stops.\n• It needs a stopping rule, so it knows when to quit instead of going forever."}
